meta.notes: type/power/accuracy/cls are indexed by move id (newest values; accuracy 0 means no accuracy check / never misses). byGen[g][id] = [type, power] where Gen g differs; accuracyByGen[g][id] overrides accuracy where Gen g differs. effect[id] is the PokeAPI move effect group; effectByGen[g][id] overrides it where the generation differs. effectText uses short_effect, with English and French prose. Before Gen 4 the damage class follows the type, not cls.
